### Problem Description
Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...").

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the interface/feature should function.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Design Mockups / Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup designs, screenshots, or code examples that describe the feature request here.
